name: GDI-Bench-Plus
description: A benchmark suite for evaluating generative image/text models (GDI-style models) on a variety of image generation and related multimodal tasks. It provides prompts and reference evaluations to measure fidelity, alignment, and safety of generated images.
evaluation_method: human_eval (preference and safety judgments) and automatic image-quality metrics (e.g., FID) where applicable
reputation: An emerging benchmark within the image-generation community for assessing both quality and alignment/safety; adoption is growing but not yet widespread.
